summary: HCW Biologics Inc. filed an 8-K to report the settlement of two vendor disputes. On June 26, 2026, B I Contractors filed a voluntary dismissal with prejudice and a final satisfaction of lien, removing a $1.1M lien and extinguishing disputed accounts payable. Separately, on May 26, 2026, the company paid $620k completing a previously-agreed settlement with EirGenix, reducing a $1.7M obligation to $1.2M. These are routine legal/litigation settlements, not a special situation corporate transaction. No board recommendation or deal terms apply. Watch for any impact on liquidity.
